title: LLM Gateway With Fallbacks
tagline: Route a bounded request through providers with explicit failure semantics.
summary: Build an HTTP gateway library with endpoint validation, response limits, retry classification and a total-attempt budget. Offline tests inject a real net/http transport interface, while applications can use the standard HTTP client for live endpoints.
usefulFor: Route a bounded request through providers with explicit failure semantics.
Offline experiments with explicit failure cases and limits
youWillBuild: Build an HTTP gateway library with endpoint validation, response limits, retry classification and a total-attempt budget. Offline tests inject a real net/http transport interface, while applications can use the standard HTTP client for live endpoints.

stages.title: Validate provider endpoints
stages.summary: Allow HTTPS endpoints and explicit loopback HTTP fixtures, reject embedded credentials and fragments, and deduplicate providers without changing order.

stages.title: Classify failures without retrying everything
stages.summary: A success is exactly an HTTP 2xx response.

stages.title: Send one bounded HTTP request
stages.summary: Use net/http with the caller context, a JSON POST body and a response byte ceiling.

stages.title: Route with a total-attempt budget
stages.summary: Visit each validated provider once, stopping at success, a terminal client error, cancellation or the total attempt limit.
